summary: Iteration 10 / Nexus AI v9 — BYOK (Hunter.io + Resend) + Resend inbound webhook validation. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_nexus_v9_byok_hunter_resend.py (26 tests, 26/26 PASS in 31.46s on first run). Coverage: (1) GET /api/integrations/keys — 401 without auth, full shape (hunter.connected, hunter.mask, resend.connected, resend.mask, resend.from_email, updated_at), zero raw-key leakage even when keys exist in DB. (2) PUT /api/integrations/keys — 400 on empty body, partial updates work (hunter-only PUT does not clobber resend), resend_from_email validated as EmailStr. (3) DELETE /api/integrations/keys/{provider} — 400 on invalid provider ('bogus'), 'hunter' unset preserves 'resend' and vice-versa. (4) POST /api/integrations/hunter/find — 400 when no key, 200 with literal 'test-api-key' returning the documented {email,score,verified,source} shape (Hunter dev mode dummy data, no credits consumed). (5) POST /api/integrations/hunter/verify — 400 when no key, 200 with test-api-key returning {email,status,score}. (6) POST /api/webhook/resend-inbound — confirmed PUBLIC (no auth needed), responds in <5s (fire-and-forget Claude draft path verified), 400 on invalid JSON, ignores non-'received' events, persists unmatched replies as linked=false, matches outbound by in-reply-to header (seeded email_outbox row with provider_id, sent matching webhook, got matched=true + reply_id, verified email_replies row linked=true with original_email_id=outbound.id). (7) Promote-target Hunter auto-discovery — set hunter_api_key=test-api-key, found/created an unpromoted target without decision_maker_email, POSTed /api/targets/{id}/promote and confirmed response.hunter_score key is present (value may be None when Hunter test-key returns email:null — that's expected per the dummy-data contract; path is wired and does not error). (8) Per-user Resend key override — wiped gmail_credentials, deleted hunter key (so synthetic recipient is used), set resend_api_key='fake_user_key_zzz', promoted; resulting email_outbox row has provider='resend' and status/error confirms the user's fake key was used (auth/invalid-key signal), proving the override path (api_key_override in send_email) is engaged — NOT the env RESEND_API_KEY. (9) Mongo state — explicit assertion that the raw 'hunter_api_key' and 'resend_api_key' string values exist in Mongo but NEVER appear in any GET /keys response body. (10) Regression sweep — hero-stats, waitlist count, trial-status, gmail status, leads/scan, auth/me all still 200. Also ran full v8 suite (26/26 PASS in 24.22s) to confirm zero regression on prior features.
critical_code_review_comments: GOOD: routers/integrations_keys.py:_mask() returns '****' for short/empty keys and '…XXXX' for real keys — never returns the raw key. Verified at runtime that 'test-api-key' and 'fake_user_key_xxxx' are absent from every GET /keys response body even though they're stored in Mongo.
GOOD: PUT /integrations/keys uses Pydantic Optional[str] with None sentinel, so partial updates work safely (hunter-only PUT does not erase resend). Empty body raises 400 'Nothing to update'.
GOOD: DELETE /integrations/keys/{provider} whitelists only 'hunter' or 'resend' (400 otherwise) and uses $unset so the other provider's key is preserved.

GOOD: webhooks.py:resend_inbound() uses asyncio.create_task(_draft_bg()) for the Claude draft — measured <5s response time on both matched and unmatched paths, satisfying the Resend webhook timeout contract.
GOOD: webhooks.py persists unmatched replies (linked=False, user_id=None) so they don't get silently dropped — operator can still review them in email_replies.
GOOD: server.py:489-516 (promote_target Hunter branch) is wrapped in try/except so any Hunter API failure logs a warning and falls through to the synthetic email — does NOT block the promote flow.
GOOD: server.py:520-528 reads per-user resend key from user_integration_keys before send_email() call, with try/except so missing collection doesn't crash promote.

GOOD: integrations/notifications.py send_email() respects api_key_override + from_email_override — verified by setting fake_user_key_zzz at the user level and observing the resulting email_outbox row has status/error consistent with that key being used (not env).
GOOD: hunter_client.py uses httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=15s) + exponential backoff on 403/429 (max 2 retries), and never logs/persists the api_key.

MINOR (informational, not a bug): routers/integrations_keys.py:_mask() uses an ellipsis character (…) which is non-ASCII. Fine for a UI string but if any client does byte-level comparison it could surprise them — consider '...XXXX' or just 'XXXX' for ASCII safety. Not a functional issue.

MINOR (informational): GET /integrations/keys returns resend.from_email as empty string '' when unset (rather than null). Consistent but slightly non-idiomatic for the rest of the API which uses None/null elsewhere.

context_for_next_testing_agent: test_nexus_v9_byok_hunter_resend.py is now the canonical regression for BYOK + Resend inbound webhook. Important contracts to preserve when changing code: (a) GET /api/integrations/keys MUST NOT include any string that appears in the DB's hunter_api_key/resend_api_key fields — the test asserts this at byte level on the response.text; (b) Hunter accepts literal 'test-api-key' as a dev key — do NOT replace this in tests with a real key, it would burn paid credits; (c) /api/webhook/resend-inbound MUST respond in <5s (asyncio.create_task for Claude draft is non-negotiable for Resend's webhook timeout); (d) the autouse fixture clears user_integration_keys for demo-user-001 before the module — if you re-order tests, keep TestIntegrationKeysCRUD::test_get_keys_initial_empty first, and don't assume keys are present in later tests without re-setting them; (e) the per-user Resend override test wipes gmail_credentials to force the resend code path — if you connect Gmail for demo later, this test will need adjustment. Run with: python -m pytest backend/tests/test_nexus_v9_byok_hunter_resend.py backend/tests/test_nexus_v8_new_features.py -v
rca of the issue: No issues found. All 10 review_request items verified PASS on first run. The BYOK wiring is clean: (a) keys are stored plaintext in Mongo user_integration_keys but never leaked via the API (mask-only via _mask()); (b) Hunter test-api-key path works end-to-end (find + verify return the documented shape, no credits consumed); (c) Resend inbound webhook is public, fast (<5s due to fire-and-forget Claude draft), correctly matches outbound by in-reply-to header AND falls back to recipient match; (d) promote_target threads the per-user Hunter key (response.hunter_score key always present) and the per-user Resend key (api_key_override flows through send_email()) — verified by observing the email_outbox row's provider='resend' + auth-failure error when a fake user key is set. Mongo state contract honored: raw keys exist in DB, never in API responses.
